hits.snippet: New Delhi: It’s August 31, and Antim Panghal has turned 22. She is seeking blessings and some birthday cheer. She approaches a small group of journalists in the dimly-lit KD Jadhav Hall at Delhi’s Indira Gandhi Stadium with a smile and a box of sweets, her gaze occasionally shifting to the mat where the selection trials for the under-23 World Championships are on. {{^htLoading}
